en: Romans 8

p.src: 1  There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

ja: む者には、有罪判決がありません。
en: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
u.src: 1  There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

ja: 8:1 NUは「肉に従って歩まず、霊に従って歩む者」を省いている。
en: 8:1 NU omits “who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit”

p.src: 2  For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

ja: キリスト・イエスにある
en: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
u.src: 2  For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

p.src: 3  For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

ja: くなったために律法にはできなかったことを、
は成し遂げられました。ご
en: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,
u.src: 3  For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

p.src: 4  that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

en: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
u.src: 4  that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

p.src: 5  For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

en: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
u.src: 5  For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

p.src: 6  For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

en: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;
u.src: 6  For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

p.src: 7  because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

ja: うこともできないからです。
en: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
u.src: 7  because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

p.src: 8  Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

ja: ばせることができません。
en: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
u.src: 8  Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

p.src: 9  But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

ja: があなたがたのうちに
んでいるなら、あなたがたは
のうちにいます。キリストの
は、キリストのものではありません。
en: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.
u.src: 9  But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

p.src: 10  If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

ja: キリストがあなたがたのうちにおられるなら、体は
のゆえに生きています。
en: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
u.src: 10  If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

p.src: 11  But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

ja: があなたがたのうちに
んでいるなら、キリスト・イエスを
は、あなたがたのうちに
によって、あなたがたの
ぬべき体にも命を与えてくださいます。
en: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
u.src: 11  But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

p.src: 12  So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

ja: っているのではありません。
en: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
u.src: 12  So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

p.src: 13  For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

ja: きるなら、あなたがたは
ななければなりません。しかし、
en: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
u.src: 13  For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

p.src: 14  For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

en: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
u.src: 14  For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

p.src: 15  For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

en: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
u.src: 15  For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

ja: 8:15 「アバ」は「父」または「お父さん」を意味するアラム語で、天の父に祈るとき、親愛と敬意を込めて用いることができる。
en: 8:15 Abba is an Aramaic word for “Father” or “Daddy”, which can be used affectionately and respectfully in prayer to our Father in heaven.

p.src: 16  The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

ja: どもであることをあかししてくださいます。
en: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;
u.src: 16  The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

p.src: 17  and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

ja: けることにもなるのです。
en: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.
u.src: 17  and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

p.src: 18  For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

ja: べるに値しないと、私は考えます。
en: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
u.src: 18  For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

p.src: 19  For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

en: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
u.src: 19  For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

p.src: 20  For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

ja: ら望んだからではなく、服
によるものでした。しかし、そこには希望があります。
en: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
u.src: 20  For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

p.src: 21  that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

ja: ちることへの束縛から
en: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
u.src: 21  that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

p.src: 22  For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

ja: しみを味わっていることを、私たちは
en: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.
u.src: 22  For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

p.src: 23  Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

ja: それだけではありません。聖
とされること、すなわち自分の体が
en: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.
u.src: 23  Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

p.src: 24  For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

ja: えているものを、だれがなお
en: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
u.src: 24  For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

zh: 8:24 有古卷：人所看見的何必再盼望呢

p.src: 25  But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

en: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.
u.src: 25  But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

p.src: 26  In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

ja: にできないうめきをもって
たちのために執り成してくださいます。
en: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
u.src: 26  In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

p.src: 27  He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

ja: であるかをご存じです。聖
たちのために執り成してくださるからです。
en: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.
u.src: 27  He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

p.src: 28  We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

ja: 々のためには、すべてのことが
となることを、私たちは
en: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
u.src: 28  We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

p.src: 29  For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

ja: となるようにあらかじめ
en: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
u.src: 29  For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

ja: 8:29 ここや、文脈上可能な箇所で「兄弟たち」と訳された言葉は、「兄弟姉妹」または「きょうだいたち」と訳すこともできる。
en: 8:29 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

p.src: 30  Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

en: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.
u.src: 30  Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

p.src: 31  What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

ja: では、これらのことについて
en: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
u.src: 31  What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

p.src: 32  He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

ja: に、すべてのものを私たちに無償で与えてくださらないことがあるでしょうか。
en: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
u.src: 32  He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

p.src: 33  Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

ja: えることができるでしょう。
en: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.
u.src: 33  Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

zh: 8:33 或譯：是稱他們為義的上帝嗎

p.src: 34  Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

ja: める者がいるでしょうか。キリストは、
んでくださった方、いや、それ以上に、死者の中からよみがえらされ、
en: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
u.src: 34  Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

zh: 8:34 有基督......或譯：是已經死了，而且從死裏復活，現今在上帝的右邊，也替我們祈求的基督耶穌嗎

p.src: 35  Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

ja: すことができるでしょう。苦
en: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
u.src: 35  Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

p.src: 36  Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

ja: かれています。 「あなたのために、
のようにみなされています。」
en: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
u.src: 36  Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

en: 8:36 Psalms 44:22

p.src: 37  No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

ja: いいえ、これらすべての中にあっても、
en: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
u.src: 37  No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

p.src: 38  For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

ja: たちも、今あるものも後に来るものも、
en: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
u.src: 38  For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

p.src: 39  nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ja: いところにあるものも深いところにあるものも、そのほかどんな
キリスト・イエスにある
en: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
u.src: 39  nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
